definitions: Inclination or prejudice for or against one person or group, especially in a way considered to be unfair.
A concentration on or interest in one particular area or subject.
A direction diagonal to the grain of a fabric.
In games such as bowls, the irregular shape of a bowl which causes it to curve when rolled.
examples: A strong bias towards the sciences.
The dress was cut on the bias.
The bowl has a slight bias to the left.
